transcript.content: Andrews default filter is set to everyone.

Just so I've got this straight — is the issue that when Andrew opens the Review queue, the technician filter on the call list keeps resetting to "Everyone" instead of remembering his own selection (or defaulting to him), so he sees everyone's calls?
Got it — so the Review queue's filter isn't remembering his choice between visits. One thing that'd help narrow it down: does this happen for other technicians too, or just Andrew's account?
all techs. Chris says his are filtered to his when he logs in, but others are saying they have to filter each time.

That's enough for me to work with, thanks. My best read: the Review queue's filter is probably saved per-browser (e.g. in local storage) rather than per-user on the server, so techs on shared machines, new browsers, or cleared data lose their setting — while Chris's happens to have stuck. Worth checking whether the ones losing it use different browsers or the companion app/PWA, where storage can be isolated. You can press Submit now and I'll pass this on.
